Page-face Office box reads 'SURVEYOR' in hand-printed capitals with no 'County' prefix (index.csv carries 'County Surveyor' from the channel listing); the page face is what is recorded and no office was inferred. Page-face candidate 'Anthony Canto'; index.csv's channel label is 'Anthony D Canto' — a middle initial the page does not print. THE 2024 CANTO CLUSTER — THIS IS KIND (3), THE SAME REPORT RE-PUBLISHED WITH A REDACTION PASS. The county published Canto's 2024 material under three filenames and this is the county_sheet copy of the SAME report as '2024_Anthony_Canto.pdf' (key 52270376, the state_municipal copy published in the clear). Evidence, all from the page faces: (a) same report type ticked, same hand-written Date of Report 10/24/24 on all four sheets, same hand-foliation; (b) row-by-row the two ledgers are IDENTICAL — same 2 contribution rows and same 3 expenditure rows, same month-only dates, same donors, same vendors, same purposes, same 5 amounts, same 6 printed totals, same handwriting and same ink; (c) the two documents' pp2-4 measure identically to the hundredth of a percent under rowbands (same skew, same 16/15 rule counts, same band tops, same five vertical rules), i.e. the same underlying scan; (d) THE ONLY DIFFERENCE IS ON THE COVER, where this copy carries black CLERK REDACTION BARS over the candidate's street address, his telephone number and his signature, which the other copy prints in the clear. The three files are byte-DIFFERENT (three distinct sha256) but this pair is one report published twice with different redaction treatment — 'same filer, same cycle, opposite redaction practice' (K4), here on the same report. Nothing was merged, netted or differenced; each copy was transcribed on its own terms. INDEPENDENT AGREEMENT IS CORROBORATION: this reading was taken from this document's own pages and agrees with 52270376's on all 5 amounts and all 6 printed totals, strengthening both. PRIVACY: the redaction bar IS the document here — the county blacked out the street address, phone and signature on this copy; neither that data nor the unredacted copy's version of it is carried into any field or note of this record.
